# Bid the membrane, the tear-off, and the insulation.

> Price a low-slope TPO, EPDM, PVC, or modified-bitumen roof from the membrane squares a per-square special cannot see, the tear-off, the insulation, and the parapet — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
